title: If the list cannot load, the page says so above the tabs
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: The credit term list cannot be loaded for a moment when you open the Credit Terms page.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Settings page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "Credit Terms" while the list cannot be loaded.
  2. Reload the page once the list can be loaded again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the line "Something went wrong loading credit terms. Please try again." shows above the tabs, and it stays there.
  • Step 2: the line is gone and the terms show.

A manual tester cannot force the list to fail (switching the network off shows the browser's or the app's offline message instead); this case is for an automated check or a developer-made failure.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • Story 1, Error Handling: “If the list cannot be loaded, the page shows the line "Something went wrong loading credit terms. Please try again." above the tabs. It stays until the page is reloaded successfully.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms list fails to load | "Something went wrong loading credit terms. Please try again." | Inline line above the tabs, stays until a reload succeeds”
